guards: Exact source raw lemma row/sense + whole word raw row/sense only; no suffix inference or table-only authority.
Single explicit accusative lo/la/los/las only, selected nonhuman/inanimate it/them; no animate him/her or generic animate-it permission.

Only reviewed source infinitives or positive imperatives; command subject/addressee distinct from object number/gender. Formal third-person grammar means usted/ustedes command, not declarative he/she.
No finite indicative, dative, se/reflexive, multiple clitics, negatives, copular predicate proforms or modal auxiliary complement recovery.

Retain archaic/obsolete/regional/vulgar labels for exact selected senses. FOLLAR destruction is explicitly obsolete; HABER possession explicitly obsolete; modern sexual FOLLAR is separate and warned about.
CASAR legal overturn is an independently documented homograph; marriage sense remains outside inanimate policy.
